name: Inner Mongolia Yuan Xing Energy Co.,Ltd
summary: Operating primarily within China, Inner Mongolia Yuan Xing Energy Co., Ltd. is involved in a diverse range of businesses, including soda ash, methanol, agricultural resources, and coal. The company produces and supplies soda ash and baking soda, critical components used in sectors such as glass, alumina, inorganic salts, detergents, food, animal feed, and medical and health industries. Its offerings also extend to methanol and its downstream derivatives like dimethylformamide and trimethylamine, which are utilized in the creation of olefins, formaldehyde, and acetic acid. Furthermore, it provides agricultural materials, notably urea and other various fertilizers and farming products. Founded in 1997, the company was originally named Inner Mongolia Yuanxing Natural Soda Co., Ltd. and officially adopted its current designation, Inner Mongolia Yuan Xing Energy Co., Ltd., in August 2007. Its operations are based in Ordos, China.
